numinance.kinds.v1.AuthoredConstraint.js.description: AuthoredConstraint is one constraint with its provenance; a prompt labels its text untrusted.

id.description: id is required: the rule or control id within origin.

origin.description: origin is required: the kind and name of the object it comes from, such as "ArchitecturePack/company-python".

origin_digest.description: origin_digest is required: the digest of the origin as the lockfile or the signed policy bundle pins it.

statement.description: statement is the constraint text as its origin states it, for display only.

trust.description: trust is required and is TRUST_CLASS_SIGNED_POLICY or TRUST_CLASS_KERNEL; a decoder refuses any other value.
trust.title: Trust Class

numinance.kinds.v1.AuthoredConstraint.js.title: Authored Constraint

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleBudgetUsed.json.description: BundleBudgetUsed is what building the bundle consumed, checked against the stage budget of the profile.

calls.description: calls is the number of resolver searches and fetches.

ms.description: ms is the wall-clock time in milliseconds.

tokens.description: tokens is the bundle size in tokens.

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleBudgetUsed.json.title: Bundle Budget Used

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleConflict.jsonsc.description: BundleConflict is one disagreement between sources: what it is about and the source section of every claim.

claims.description: claims has at least two entries, each the section of a source that makes one claim.

topic.description: topic is required: what the sources disagree on.

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleConflict.jsonsc.title: Bundle Conflict

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleQuery.jsonschem.description: BundleQuery is one search: the tool, the digest of its arguments, how many results it returned and whether it was cut.

args_digest.description: args_digest is required: the digest of the canonical arguments, never the arguments.

results.description: results is the number of results returned.

tool.description: tool is required: the tool name as the connection pins it.

truncated.description: truncated is true when the results were cut at a cap.

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleQuery.jsonschem.title: Bundle Query

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleResolver.jsonsc.description: BundleResolver names the resolver model and prompt.
numinance.kinds.v1.BundleResolver.jsonsc.title: Bundle Resolver

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleSource.jsonsche.description: BundleSource is one selected source; its content is the artifact with this digest, delivered read-only to the worktree.

access_basis.description: access_basis is required: whose authority the fetch ran under.
access_basis.title: Knowledge Auth

classification.description: classification is the source's data classification as the source system reports it.

digest.description: digest is required: the digest of the redacted content delivered to the executor.

rank.description: rank is the source's position in the selection, from 1.

redactions.description: redactions is the number of secrets and PII spans redacted before persistence.

ref.description: ref is required and unique: the canonical source reference, redacted, since a ref can hold a credential.

selection_reason.description: selection_reason is required: why the resolver selected the source.

source_version.description: source_version is the version or ETag the source reported; absent when it reports none.

system.description: system is required: the KnowledgeConnection name the source was read through.

title.description: title is the source's own title.

trust.description: trust is required and is TRUST_CLASS_UNTRUSTED_RETRIEVED; a decoder refuses any other value.
trust.title: Trust Class

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleSource.jsonsche.title: Bundle Source

numinance.kinds.v1.CitedGuidance.jsonsch.description: CitedGuidance points at one section of a source.

ref.description: ref is required and is the ref of a source in the bundle.

section.description: section is the section id the bundle tool serves; absent means the whole source.

numinance.kinds.v1.CitedGuidance.jsonsch.title: Cited Guidance

numinance.kinds.v1.ContextBundle.jsonsch.description:
ContextBundle is the knowledge selected for one stage of one work unit,
 produced by the knowledge context, stored by digest and never mutated (a refresh opens a new context_generation). It
 is never configuration: no metadata, no extensions, and the kind loader refuses it. Every text field is untrusted,
 labelled as such in a prompt, one line of at most 1024 bytes without control or bidi characters (the knowledge decoder).
numinance.kinds.v1.ContextBundle.jsonsch.title: Context Bundle

numinance.kinds.v1.ContextBundleSpec.jso.description: ContextBundleSpec is the bundle; relevance scores are not stored because they are not reproducible.

authored_constraints.description: authored_constraints come only from the resolved profile's policy and packs; enforcement comes from the grant.

authz_context_digest.description: authz_context_digest is required: the AuthorizationContext digest every search and fetch ran under.

budget_used.description: budget_used is required: what building the bundle consumed.

change_id.description: change_id is required: the Change the bundle was built for.

cited_guidance.description: cited_guidance points at sections of the sources; it is advisory only and untrusted.

conflicts.description: conflicts lists sources that disagree; a conflict a pack's precedence resolves is left out, none silently.

context_generation.description: context_generation is the resolution generation, from 1; a refresh opens a new one and never changes an earlier bundle.

pinned_toolsets.description: pinned_toolsets maps each KnowledgeConnection name to the digest of the tool inventory pinned when it was read.

query_plan.description: query_plan lists the searches the resolver ran, in order.

receipts.description: receipts holds the artifact digest of the retrieval receipt of every search and fetch; the bundle does not repeat them.

resolver.description: resolver is required: the model and prompt that planned the queries and selected the sources.

sources.description: sources lists the selected sources, unique by ref.

stage.description: stage is required: the stage name the bundle serves.

unresolved_questions.description: unresolved_questions are what the sources did not answer; a model wrote them from untrusted input, so they are untrusted.

work_unit_id.description: work_unit_id is required: the work unit the bundle was built for.

numinance.kinds.v1.ContextBundleSpec.jso.title: Context Bundle Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.UnresolvedQuestion.js.description: UnresolvedQuestion is one question the sources did not answer.

blocking.description: blocking is true when the Change cannot proceed without an answer; the question is then posted to the ticket.

numinance.kinds.v1.UnresolvedQuestion.js.title: Unresolved Question

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.description: Digest is a sha256 content digest as "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters.

value.description:
value is exactly "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other
 length, case or prefix, and an empty value in a present message, is
 rejected. Absence is the unset message.

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.title: Digest
